## Prior art

- [doi:10.1007/s00373-014-1422-4](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00373-014-1422-4) (Remark 1, p. 1089), checked 2026-10-18: No exact order-14 value; Remark 1 covers n = 9 to 12 only.
- [doi:10.1016/j.disc.2025.114504](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.disc.2025.114504), checked 2026-10-18: Gives the matching 19-edge upper bound, not exactness.
- [doi:10.37236/41](https://doi.org/10.37236/41) (Theorem 19, Conjecture 1), checked 2026-10-21: Conjecture 1, attributed to the 2015 Zhang-Luo-Shigeno paper: sat(n,C6) = floor((3n-3)/2) for n \>= 9, predicting 19 at n = 14. No exact order-14 value is listed.
